race.comment: SIMPLY LUSCIOUS (3) displayed all of her customary dash to lead all the way and take out a 1000m BM56 at Tatura last start. Perfectly placed back to 900m and from a decent draw is a big chance to run them ragged again. THE SHYSTER (6) firmed to start a $2.30 favourite on debut and gave backers no cause for concern, leading from the get-go and demolishing his rivals over 1100m at Tatura. Coming back 200m doesn't look to be an issue. Draws a nice gate and looks good enough to handle this class rise. POSTWAR (11) needed the run last time out at Leeton when fresh from a 53-day break. Beaten narrowly in a thriller over 1000m under 61.5kgs in heavy going the run prior - that is a decent form reference. MAJESTIC REWARD (7) is back after a four-month spell. Raced once last prep and got home by a head over 1000m at Narrandera. Lightly raced mare who cannot be underestimated. CALAIS BLISS (2) goes very fast and copes with soft tracks so keep her in mind for the exotics.
